வணக்கம்! 🙏

Welcome to EDMS — Election Data Management System.
How can I help you today?

📋 *Step 1 — Your Role*

Select the role that best describes you:

🏛️ *Step 2 — Party Affiliation*

Are you affiliated with a political party?

🗺️ *Step 3 — Local Body Type*

Which type of local body are you contesting / working in?

🏠 *Step 7 — Booth / Ward Number*

Please type your booth or ward number (e.g. 42):

✅ *Registration Received!*

Thank you for registering with EDMS.

📱 Your login credentials will be sent to this WhatsApp number within *15 minutes*.

• Login at: *edms.tnbjp.org*
• Use your WhatsApp number as your username
• Type *Support* if you need help

Good luck! 🙏

🔐 *Retrieve Your Credentials*

Enter your registered phone number to receive your login details:

📨 *Credentials Sent!*

If your number is registered, your login details have been sent to this WhatsApp.

• Login at *edms.tnbjp.org*
• Use your WhatsApp number as username

Type *Support* if you need help.

🎬 *EDMS Live Demo*

See EDMS before you register!

📹 Demo video: https://edms.tnbjp.org/demo

✨ *What you will see:*
• Voter data by booth
• Candidate dashboard
• WhatsApp registration flow
• Reports and analytics

💡 Ready? Type *Register*
Questions? Type *Support*

⭐ *EDMS Benefits*

🗳️ *For Candidates:*
• Booth-level voter data
• Voter turnout tracking
• Targeted outreach lists

📊 *For Party Workers:*
• Ward performance dashboards
• Voter contact export
• Field team coordination

📱 *All Users:*
• WhatsApp access — no app to install
• Secure login with your number
• 24x7 access during election period

Type *Purchase Plan* for pricing.

❓ *Frequently Asked Questions*

*What is EDMS?*
Election Data Management System for TN local body elections 2026.

*Who can register?*
Candidates, booth agents, party workers and leaders.

*How do I access data?*
Log in at edms.tnbjp.org after registration.

*Is data secure?*
Yes. Only verified registered users can access voter data.

*What areas are covered?*
All 38 TN districts, 234 assembly constituencies.

More questions? Type *Support*

🌐 *EDMS Website*

🔗 Login/Dashboard: https://edms.tnbjp.org
📋 Register: https://edms.tnbjp.org/register
📞 Support: https://edms.tnbjp.org/support

Type *Register* to begin.

🆘 *EDMS Support*

Describe your issue and we will respond within 2 hours:

✅ *Support Request Received!*

Our team will respond within *2 hours*.

For urgent issues:
📞 Call: +91 98765 43210
⏰ Hours: 8am to 10pm daily

Thank you! 🙏

💳 *How to Purchase*

1. Visit: https://edms.tnbjp.org/purchase
2. Log in (or register first)
3. Select your plan
4. Pay via UPI, card or net banking

Credentials activated within *30 minutes* of payment.

Type *Support* for help.

📣 *Campaign Request*

Fill in your campaign details:

✅ *Campaign Request Submitted!*

Our team will contact you within *4 hours* to confirm:
• Target audience and area
• Message approval
• Pricing and schedule

Type *Menu* to return to main menu.
